propositions: Two JSON surfaces (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers, causing confusion about whether they are derived or hand-authored and leading to incorrect edits to generated artifacts instead of sources
When plans cite derived files by line number, implementers edit the generated artifact rather than its source, causing drift gate failures and wasting CI cycles
The two JSON surfaces must carry a top-level _generated_by string field naming their regenerate command as a fixed-point marker that survives byte-identically through regeneration
Existing on-disk-equality tests must be updated to compare against the marker-bearing build_index_document() wrapper rather than the pure marker-less build_prompt_index() function

A new documentation table must enumerate all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces with their sources, regenerate commands, and enforcing gates, explicitly flagging three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces to prevent incorrect bannering

A new unit test must verify that the documentation table exactly matches the canonical registry of derived surfaces and that each generated file carries its marker, failing if any surface is omitted or marker is stripped
